# Humvee A light armoured car with a machine gun on its roof. You ride inside it: the one at the wheel drives and fires the gun, and the rest of the crew rides along in the back.
## Getting in and out There are two doors down each side. Stand at one and use the humvee with [color=yellow][bold][keybind="ActivateItemInWorld"][/bold][/color], or pick [bold]Get in[/bold] from its menu. Hold still for a moment and you're inside, standing by that door. Whoever you're pulling comes in with you.
It seats [color=orange][protodata="KsCrewVehicleHumvee" comp="KsCrewVehicleInterior" member="MaxOccupants" format="N0"/][/color]. When it's full, nobody else gets in.
To get out, stand up from your seat and use one of the doors inside. You step out beside the matching door outside. You can't get out while the humvee is moving, or if something is in the way on that side.
## Seats Click a seat with an empty hand to sit down. Sitting in the [bold]driver's seat[/bold] puts you at the wheel and on the gun: your view moves outside, above the humvee, and zooms out a little. From the passenger seats, and on your feet, you see the inside, and the world outside through its windows.
## Driving Drive with your movement keys. [color=yellow][bold][keybind="MoveUp"][/bold][/color] drives forward and [color=yellow][bold][keybind="MoveDown"][/bold][/color] backs up, the way the humvee faces, whichever way that is on your screen. [color=yellow][bold][keybind="MoveLeft"][/bold][/color] and [color=yellow][bold][keybind="MoveRight"][/bold][/color] steer.
It has wheels, so it steers only while it rolls, more sharply the faster it goes: standing still, the steering keys do nothing. Backing up, it turns the other way, as any car does.
Let go and it rolls to a stop. Your action bar has its [bold]horn[/bold] and its [bold]headlights[/bold] while you drive.
The humvee is heavy, and what it hits notices: - [bold]People.[/bold] Drive into someone fast and you run them over: they're hurt and knocked down. Slowly, they just stand in your way. - [bold]Windows, grilles and tables.[/bold] Fast enough, you smash straight through and lose some speed. Doors are never smashed: one that would open anyway opens, and a locked one stops you. - [bold]Walls.[/bold] Hit one fast and you damage it and stop dead, and the humvee takes a beating too. A really hard crash stalls the engine for a few seconds.
## Firing Turn on combat mode in the driver's seat and click, or hold, where you want to shoot. The turret swings round toward your cursor and fires once it points there, so give it a moment to come round. Aiming past its reach fires the same way, as far as it reaches.
The alert at the side of your screen counts the rounds left.
## Reloading The gun takes .30 rifle rounds. Use them on the [bold]ammo loader[/bold] standing between the seats: loose rounds, a box or a magazine all work, and it takes as many as fit, after a few seconds. Examine the loader to see how full the gun is.
## Damage The hull soaks up a lot. Once it's badly hurt it looks battered and smoke pours from the engine. Weld it to patch it up, a little with each pass.
If it's destroyed, it blows up. Everyone inside is thrown out around it, hurt and knocked down, and all that's left is a burnt-out wreck.
